description: Fires when column 4 holds a short stack (2-4 stones) containing opponent stones, ideally two or three of theirs, and the opponent played into column 4 within their last two moves. Empty columns 3 and 5 help; stones there, a tall or full column 4, later game, or several moves since the last column-4 move switch it off. Also briefly off right after an opponent stone lands on row 3+ of column 4 or on top of my stone.
effect: Very small: when active it slightly lowers column 3 (forcing it off raises column 3 by about 3-6 points and lowers columns 4/1 by 2-6 points).
notes: Layer-1 unit, strongly move-order dependent (same board, different order: 0.83 vs 1.70). Scores: col4 count+col5 empty F1 0.30; +recency/ply 0.39; token-recency score 0.18; additive opp-count 0.38; height-based additive 0.385/0.425 (thr 0.9/1.3); +tall-column penalty and steeper recency decay 0.545 (best, AUROC 0.76, sim share 0.48); +col3/5 recent-move penalty 0.533. Unmodelled: games starting with 4 read lower; single O at (0,4) at very low ply sometimes fires.
